behavior_detail: Runtime function and line coverage is produced by the aggregate RFC L2 suite.
Feature and test counts are static traceability signals, not proof of scenario pass or source execution.
recommendations: Review aggregate runtime coverage after each PR and add targeted L2 cases for uncovered RFC execution paths.
Keep unit-test counters excluded from L2 artifacts.
infrastructure_notes: L2 runs in the native-platform container against the mock-xconf service.
LCOV is filtered to RFC production roots and excludes /usr, gtest, and mocks.
Coverage collection requires normal rfcMgr process exits so the gcov runtime writes .gcda counters.
The shared Markdown generator heuristically inventories C functions; RFC native LCOV/HTML remain the authoritative runtime line evidence for C++ sources.
The report is aggregate and does not attribute coverage to individual features or tests.
